faq.q1: ホテル・シェルパ・ソウルはどこにありますか？
faq.a1: ネパール・カトマンズのタメル地区、バガワティ・マーグに位置しています。
faq.q2: どんな部屋タイプがありますか？
faq.a2: エコノミーファミリールーム($20/泊)、デラックスルーム($20/泊)、ファミリールーム($30/泊)の3タイプがございます。
faq.q3: ホテル内にレストランはありますか？
faq.a3: いいえ。静かな環境と快適な睡眠を守るため、館内レストランは運営しておりません。
faq.q4: 専用駐車場はありますか？
faq.a4: 専用駐車場はございません。駐車場が必要な場合は事前にお問い合わせください。
faq.q5: エアコンは付いていますか？
faq.a5: エアコン設備の記載があるお部屋にてご利用いただけます。
faq.a6: はい、館内全域で高速Wi-Fiを無料でご利用いただけます。
faq.q7: 共用キッチンはありますか？
faq.a7: はい、1週間以上の長期滞在ゲスト専用の自炊キッチンをご用意しています。
faq.q8: 誰が共用キッチンを利用できますか？
faq.a8: 清潔で静かな環境を保つため、登録された長期滞在ゲストのみご利用いただけます。
faq.q9: 空港からどのくらいかかりますか？
faq.a9: トリブバン国際空港から車で約20分です（交通状況により変動します）。
faq.q10: パシュパティナート寺院まではどのくらいですか？
faq.q11: ボダナート・ストゥーパまではどのくらいですか？
faq.q12: 予約方法を教えてください。
faq.a12: 当ウェブサイトから直接予約、またはWhatsAppやお電話で空室状況をお問い合わせいただけます。

homeFAQSection.title: Helpful Information for Your Stay
homeFAQSection.subtitle: Real, verified information about staying at Hotel Sherpa Soul in Thamel, Kathmandu.
homeFAQSection.helpText: Our 24/7 reception desk is available anytime via WhatsApp or phone.
homeFAQSection.q1: Where is Hotel Sherpa Soul located?
homeFAQSection.a1: Hotel Sherpa Soul is located on Thamel Bhagawati Marg 26 in the heart of Thamel, Kathmandu, Nepal. We are in a quiet alley within easy walking distance to trekking gear shops, bakeries, cafes, and historic Durbar Square.
homeFAQSection.q2: How can I reach the hotel from Tribhuvan International Airport?
homeFAQSection.a2: The hotel is approximately 6 km from Tribhuvan International Airport (KTM). Travel time is typically 20 to 30 minutes by taxi or private transfer depending on city traffic.
homeFAQSection.q3: Does the hotel offer airport pickup?
homeFAQSection.a3: Yes, we arrange reliable airport pickup and drop-off transfers directly between Kathmandu Airport and the hotel. You can request an airport transfer when booking directly or by contacting our front desk via WhatsApp at +977 9818259472.
homeFAQSection.q4: Is luggage storage available for trekkers?
homeFAQSection.a4: Yes, we offer complimentary secure luggage storage for all guests. Trekkers venturing on multi-day journeys to Everest, Annapurna, or Langtang can safely store their non-trekking luggage with us free of charge until they return.
homeFAQSection.q5: Does the hotel have a restaurant?
homeFAQSection.a5: Designed for peaceful stays away from loud restaurant and bar noise inside the property. While we do not operate a commercial on-site restaurant or bar, we provide guests with a fully equipped shared kitchen, and hundreds of Thamel's acclaimed restaurants and bakeries are just a 1 to 3 minute walk away.
homeFAQSection.a6: Yes, Hotel Sherpa Soul provides a clean, well-equipped shared guest kitchen featuring an induction cooktop, refrigerator, microwave, and electric kettle where guests can prepare light meals, cook personal dietary favorites, or brew fresh Himalayan tea.
homeFAQSection.q7: What time is check-in and check-out?
homeFAQSection.a7: Standard check-in begins at 14:00 (2:00 PM) and check-out is until 12:00 (12:00 PM noon). Our front desk is staffed 24/7, and flexible early check-in or late check-out is accommodated whenever room availability allows.
homeFAQSection.a8: Yes, complimentary high-speed fiber-optic Wi-Fi is provided throughout the entire property, including all guest rooms, suites, and common lounge spaces.
homeFAQSection.a9: Air conditioning (AC) with heating and cooling climate control is equipped in our Deluxe Rooms and Family Rooms. Budget Family Rooms feature ceiling fans and supplemental heating.
homeFAQSection.a10: Direct bookings made via our website, WhatsApp, or phone enjoy flexible cancellation. If your travel plans change, please notify our front desk at least 24 hours prior to your scheduled arrival date.
homeFAQSection.a11: You can book directly through our official website by clicking 'Check Availability', or contact our front desk directly via WhatsApp at +977 9818259472 for instant booking confirmation with our best 10% direct rate guarantee.
